title: Explicit 3.5n - O(log n) lower bound for B2 circuits via affine dispersers and gate elimination

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The fixed total Mishra-Santhanam affine-disperser family from proof.md: for each input length n use the explicit polynomial-time affine disperser f_n : {0,1}^n -> {0,1} for dimension d = O(log n) from Li [37]. The family is total and uniform because the disperser construction is explicit and works for every length n.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"2","numerator":"7"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"2","numerator":"7"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n) >= (7/2)n - O(log n) at every sufficiently large integer length n=|x| in the full Li-Yang B2 model.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
